sentences.englishText: Pompei was an ancient city in Italy.
Vesivius was a volcano near the city.
The volcano threw out poisonous gases and lava.
sentences.turkishText: Volkan dışarıya zehirli gazlar ve lav çıkardı.

sentences.englishText: It was about lunchtime and the people were at home for lunch.
sentences.turkishText: Öğle yemeği vakti sıralarıydı ve insanlar öğle yemeği için evdeydiler.

sentences.englishText: Before the eruption, there were shakes, but the people weren't afraid of them.
sentences.turkishText: Püskürmeden önce sarsıntılar olmuştu fakat insanlar korkmamıştı.

sentences.englishText: There were generally shakes in that area.
There were 20.000 people in that old town.
People and animals were in hot ash.
sentences.turkishText: İnsanlar ve hayvanlar sıcak külün içindeydiler.

sentences.englishText: Today, 2000 years later the volcano is inactive and 2 million people live in the region.
sentences.turkishText: 2000 yıl sonra, bugün volkan aktif değil ve bölgede 2 milyon insan yaşıyor.
